headline: Executive order directs the federal government to carry out the National HIV/AIDS Strategy for 2015 through 2020.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order sets up how the federal government will put into action an updated national plan on HIV/AIDS covering 2015 to 2020. No summary was provided, so the specific duties it assigns and the details of the plan are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that work on HIV/AIDS
who_it_affects.how: They are likely directed to take steps to carry out the national HIV/AIDS strategy for 2015 to 2020.

who_it_affects.group: People living with or at risk of HIV
who_it_affects.how: They are the focus of the national strategy, though the order's specific effects on them are not stated in the available information.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed July 30, 2015; the strategy covers 2015 through 2020.
